blocks.title: Biodegradable plastic
blocks.text: Woh plastic jo kuch arsa zameen mein dabe rehne par microorganisms (khurdbeeni jaandar, jaise bacteria) ke zariye qudrati tor par saada aur non-toxic compounds mein toot jaye, biodegradable plastic kehlata hai.

Jin plastics mein qudrati polymers, jaise starch (nishasta), hon woh jaldi toot'te hain, kyun ke mitti ke bacteria qudrati polymers par aasani se hamla karte hain. Polyesters aur polyamides poly(alkene)s se zyada biodegradable hain, kyun ke mitti ke jaandar hydrolysis (paani ke zariye tootna) se inhein saada hisson mein behtar tor sakte hain. Polyamides se carboxylic acids aur amines bante hain, jab ke polyesters carboxylic acids aur alcohols mein toot'te hain. Maslan poly(lactic acid) (PLA) plastic ki biodegradability barha sakta hai. Figure 26.6 mein PLA wale plastic ka kuch arse baad tootna dikhaya gaya hai (din 0 se din 45 tak aik kaanta dheere dheere ghayab ho jata hai).

blocks.prompt: Polyester poly(ethene) se zyada biodegradable kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Polyester ke ester links hydrolysis se carboxylic acids aur alcohols mein toot sakte hain, jab ke poly(ethene) mein sirf be-asar C-C aur C-H bonds hain.

items: Biodegradable: microorganisms se saada, non-toxic compounds mein tootna.
Starch wale plastics jaldi toot'te hain.
Polyamides → carboxylic acids + amines; polyesters → carboxylic acids + alcohols (hydrolysis); PLA biodegradability barhata hai.
